name_zh: 松下幸之助：從燈芯匠到經營之神的『水道哲學』體系與社會公器範式
name_en: Matsushita Konosuke: From Lamp Wick Maker to God of Management — the 'Waterway Philosophy' System and Social Instrument Paradigm
description_zh: 松下幸之助（Matsushita Konosuke，1894-1989）是日本戰後最具影響力的經營思想家之一，被譽為「經營之神」。他出生於和歌山縣有田郡九島村（現伊都郡九島町）的貧困農民家庭，8歲起到大阪當學徒，在內海電燈公司做拉線工。1918年24歲時用300日元（相當於當時一個工人一年的工資）創辦松下電器製作所，生產雙腳插座和改良型白熾燈燈頭。二戰後他創立了松下電器工業（現Panasonic），成為日本最大的電子製造商之一。其核心思維貢獻在於將「社會公器論」工程化為一套可操作的管理哲學——通過「水道哲學」（像自來水一樣大量生產、便宜供應，讓產品成為社會的基礎設施）取代傳統「利潤最大化」邏輯，確立了「企業的價值不在於賺多少錢，而在於為社會做了什麼貢獻」的經營理念。松下幸之助的獨特之處在於他幾乎沒有接受過正規教育，卻發展出了一套系統化的經營管理思想體系（「Panasonic方式」），包括「PHILosophy」（松下經營理念）、「MBC」（Management by Brain-cycle，腦循環管理）和「IPPONGI」（根本主義，專注核心價值）。他是Protreptic中模式37（社會公器經營法）在日本商業傳統中的關鍵樣本，也是模式12（系統思維）在「非科班出身者的經營體系化」場景的獨特代表。
description_en: Matsushita Konosuke (1894-1989) was one of Japan's most influential management thinkers post-war, hailed as 'God of Management'. Born to a poor farming family in Ariita-gun, Wakayama Prefecture (now Ito-gun), he went to Osaka at age 8 as an apprentice, working as a string puller at Uchigami Electric Light Company. Founded Matsushita Electric Manufacturing Co. in 1918 at age 24 with 300 yen (equivalent to a worker's annual wage), producing two-prong plugs and improved incandescent lamp sockets. Post-war he founded Matsushita Electric Industrial (now Panasonic), becoming one of Japan's largest electronics manufacturers. His core thinking contribution lies in engineering a 'Social Instrument Theory' into an operable management philosophy — replacing traditional 'profit maximization' logic with 'Waterway Philosophy' (mass-produce and supply cheaply, making products become society's infrastructure), establishing the management principle of 'enterprise value lies not in how much money earned, but what contribution made to society'. Matsushita's uniqueness lies in having almost no formal education yet developing a systematic management thought system (the 'Panasonic Way'), including PHILosophy (Matsushita Management Philosophy), MBC (Management by Brain-cycle, brain cycle management) and IPPONGI (Fundamentalism, focusing on core values). He is a key sample of mode 37 (Social Instrument Management) in Japanese commercial tradition and the unique representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'non-traditional entrepreneur systematization' scenarios.
reason_zh: 松下幸之助填補了Protreptic在「社會公器經營法」領域的日本空白。他是模式37（社會公器經營法）在「水道哲學」場景的唯一日本完整樣本，展示了如何將企業定位為社會公共設施而非單純利潤機器的管理哲學；也是模式12（系統思維）在「非科班出身者的經營體系化」場景的唯一日本代表。他的「水道哲學」（像自來水一樣大量生產、便宜供應）和「社會公器論」對現代ESG（環境、社會、治理）理念和企業社會責任理論具有深遠啟發價值。
reason_en: Matsushita Konosuke fills Protreptic's Japanese gap in 'Social Instrument Management'. He is the only complete Japanese sample of mode 37 (Social Instrument Management) in 'Waterway Philosophy' scenarios, demonstrating management philosophy of positioning enterprise as social infrastructure rather than mere profit machine; also the sole Japanese representative of mode 12 (Systems Thinking) in 'non-traditional entrepreneur systematization' scenarios. His 'Waterway Philosophy' (mass-produce and supply cheaply like tap water) and 'Social Instrument Theory' have profound heuristic value for modern ESG (environmental, social, governance) philosophy and corporate social responsibility theory.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式37社會公器經營法）：水道哲學的創立——提出「企業的價值不在於賺多少錢，而在於為社會做了什麼貢獻」的核心命題，將產品定位為如同自來水般應大量生產、便宜供應的社會基礎設施
第2步（模式12系統思維法）：Panasonic方式的體系化——創建PHILosophy（松下經營理念：正確使用電力、促進社會繁榮、提高文化水平）、MBC（Brain-cycle Management，腦循環管理：收集資訊→分析判斷→決策執行→反饋修正的閉環）和IPponGI（根本主義，專注核心價值不偏離初衷）
第3步（模式7戰略預判法）：從插座到全品類的產品擴展——從雙腳插座起步，逐步擴展到收音機、風扇、電視、電冰箱等全品類家電，確立「多品類小批量」的柔性生產模式
第4步（模式15框架效應法）：社會公器論的品牌框架——通過「社會公器」概念重新定義企業存在的意義，將商業成功框架為對社會的貢獻而非單純利潤獲取，創造了「經營即修行」的品牌敘事
第5步（範式固化）：非科班經營體系——將「水道哲學→Panasonic方式→社會公器論→經營即修行」四環沉澱為可操作的經營管理模板，證明了沒有正規教育的農民之子可以通過實踐智慧建立世界級企業
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 37 Social Instrument Management): Waterway Philosophy creation — proposing core thesis 'enterprise value lies not in money earned but contribution to society', positioning products as social infrastructure that should be mass-produced and cheaply supplied like tap water

Step 2 (Mode 12 Systems Thinking): Panasonic Way systematization — creating PHILosophy (Matsushita Management Philosophy: properly use electricity, promote social prosperity, elevate cultural level), MBC (Management by Brain-cycle: information collection → analysis → decision execution → feedback correction closed loop) and IPPONGI (Fundamentalism, focusing on core values without deviating from original purpose)

Step 3 (Mode 7 Strategic Prediction): Product category expansion from plugs to full range — starting with two-prong plugs, gradually expanding to radios, fans, TVs, refrigerators and full household appliance categories, establishing 'multi-category small-batch' flexible production model

Step 4 (Mode 15 Framing Effect): Social instrument brand framework — redefining enterprise existence meaning through 'social instrument' concept, framing business success as social contribution rather than mere profit acquisition, creating 'management as spiritual practice' brand narrative

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Non-traditional entrepreneur system — condensing 'Waterway Philosophy → Panasonic Way → Social Instrument Theory → Management as Spiritual Practice' into an operable management template, proving that a farmer's son without formal education can build world-class enterprise through practical wisdom
expected_zh: 掌握松下幸之助從插座到全品類家電的擴展路徑及其水道哲學的核心邏輯
理解Panasonic方式（PHILosophy、MBC、IPponGI）的體系化結構及其對現代管理的啟發
評估其社會公器論和經營即修行理念對ESG理念和企業社會責任的持續啟發價值
expected_en: Master Matsushita Konosuke's expansion path from plugs to full household appliance categories and core logic of Waterway Philosophy
Understand Panasonic Way (PHILosophy, MBC, IPPONGI) systematic structure and its heuristic value for modern management
Evaluate the continuing heuristic value of his Social Instrument Theory and Management as Spiritual Practice philosophy for ESG concepts and corporate social responsibility
case_zh: 1894年出生於和歌山縣有田郡九島村的貧困農民家庭，在家七兄弟中排行第八。8歲（1902年）到大阪進入內海電燈公司做拉線工學徒，每月僅30日元。1912年辭職進入大阪的日置商店（電器配件批發商），負責銷售白熾燈燈頭。1918年用積蓄的300日元和妻子靜子的陪嫁首飾創辦松下電器製作所，生產改良型雙腳插座和白熾燈燈頭。1923年關東大地震後大量訂單使公司迅速擴張。1929年全球經濟大蕭條期間，通過「即使生意不好也要堅持經營」的信念維持公司。1932年創立松下電器工業株式會社，開始生產收音機和風扇。二戰期間轉產軍需物資（防空頭燈、電池）。1946年重建松下電器工業，開始生產電視和電冰箱。1950年代確立「多品類小批量」的柔性生產模式，成為日本家電巨頭。1959年提出「社會公器論」——企業是社會的公共財產，經營者的責任是為社會做出貢獻。1964年創立松下政經塾（培養政治家和企業家的培訓機構）。1973年退休，由兒子松下正治接任社長。他的「水道哲學」（像自來水一樣大量生產、便宜供應）和「社會公器論」成為日本經營學的核心範式之一，Panasonic方式（PHILosophy + MBC + IPPONGI）被廣泛應用於現代管理教育。
case_en: Born 1894 to poor farming family in Kujima, Ariita-gun, Wakayama Prefecture, eighth of seven brothers. Went to Osaka at 8 (1902) as apprentice at Uchigami Electric Light Company, earning only 30 yen monthly. Resigned in 1912 to work at Oki Shoten (electrical component wholesaler) in Osaka, responsible for selling incandescent lamp sockets. Founded Matsushita Electric Manufacturing Co. in 1928 with savings of 300 yen and wife Shige's dowry jewelry, producing improved two-prong plugs and lamp sockets. Kanto Great Earthquake of 1923 brought massive orders, rapidly expanding the company. Survived 1929 Great Depression through belief in 'even during bad times must continue operating'. Established Matsushita Electric Industrial Co. Ltd in 1932, began producing radios and fans. During WWII converted to military supplies (air raid headlamps, batteries). Rebuilt Matsushita Electric Industrial in 1946, began producing TVs and refrigerators. Established 'multi-category small-batch' flexible production model in 1950s, becoming Japan's home appliance giant. Proposed 'Social Instrument Theory' in 1959 — enterprises are society's public property, managers' responsibility is to contribute to society. Founded Matsushita Seikei Juku (training institution for politicians and entrepreneurs) in 1964. Retired in 1973, succeeded by son Matsushita Masato as president. His 'Waterway Philosophy' (mass-produce and supply cheaply like tap water) and 'Social Instrument Theory' became one of the core paradigms of Japanese management studies; Panasonic Way (PHILosophy + MBC + IPPONGI) widely applied in modern management education.
intellectual_tradition: Self-taught Management Philosopher / Social Instrument Theory Advocate
cross_cultural_impact: Panasonic Way taught at management schools worldwide; 'Social Instrument Theory' predates modern ESG concepts by decades
legal_system: 無（戰後日本產業政策下的民間企業家）
education_tradition: 自學者（僅讀完小學，後通過實踐和管理哲學建立系統化經營思想）
scientific_contribution: 否（但其推動的消費電子普及對社會現代化有間接貢獻）
artistic_legacy: 否（但其創立的松下政經塾支持了日本政治和商業人才培養）
environmental_stewardship: 否（但Panasonic後來在環保技術領域有重要貢獻）
gender_role_innovation: 有限支持（妻子靜子在戰後協助維持公司運營，但當時社會對女性參與商業的認可度有限）
diaspora_network_type: 知識（Panasonic Way管理哲學的全球傳播）
digital_adaptation: 無（前數字時代，但其多品類戰略為後續數位化轉型奠定了組織基礎）
regional_integration: 有（Panasonic全球製造和銷售網絡的整合者）
conflict_resolution_mechanism: 經營辯證（與本田宗一郎的「社會公器 vs 技術創新」經典對話，二人共同奠定了日本戰後經濟奇蹟的基礎）
